body: Never move Codex conversation files between CODEX_HOMEs. Codex indexes them in SQLite with absolute paths (state_5.sqlite table `threads`: rollout_path + cwd), so a move orphans the index, and writing Codex's sqlx-migrated DBs from agx is unsafe. `agx sessions move` refuses Codex on purpose (Codex implements provider.MoveUnsupported with the reason). Revisit only if Codex ships an import/re-index command (decided 2026-09-24, AGX-005).
